definitions.gloss: shopping trip for supplies; bulk purchasing
definitions.explanation: going out specifically to buy supplies or provisions, often in larger quantities

examples.japanese: {食材|しょくざい}の{買|か}い{出|だ}しに{行|い}く。
パーティーの{買|か}い{出|だ}しを{頼|たの}まれた。
examples.english: I was asked to go buy supplies for the party.

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}にまとめて{買|か}い{出|だ}しをする{家庭|かてい}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Many households do their bulk shopping on weekends.

notes:
USAGE:
- {買|か}い{出|だ}しに{行|い}く (to go on a shopping trip)
- {買|か}い{出|だ}しを{頼|たの}む (to ask someone to do the shopping)
- {食材|しょくざい}の{買|か}い{出|だ}し (grocery shopping)

NUANCE:
Implies a purposeful trip to acquire supplies, often for an event, meal preparation, or stocking up. Different from casual shopping ({買|か}い{物|もの}).

RELATED:
- まとめ{買|が}い (bulk buying - the act of buying in quantity)
- {買|か}いだめ (stocking up)
- {買|か}い{物|もの} (shopping - general)
